about.title: About Me
description: Hi! Nice to meet you. Here's a bit about me: I hold a Master of Science in Computer Engineering with a focus on cybersecurity from Politecnico di Torino, obtained in 2023. During my academic journey I developed a PRNG based on chaotic maps, contributed to CyberChallenge.IT and led project teams in collaboration with Aruba S.p.A.
Currently, I work at Liquid Reply as a Consultant focused on LLM integration in the infrastructure workflow and LLM Agent development.

roles.description: As an Advisor for Logistics and Fundraising at Mu Nu, I provide strategic guidance and mentorship to the chapter's leadership team. In this role, I assist in planning and coordinating hackathons, talks, conferences, and address cross-functional matters.

roles.title: Team Leader at Challenge@PoliTo by Firms - Become Passwordless
roles.description: As student for the Aruba Academy program, I developed and integrated mobile, desktop and web application access methodologies based on common passwordless access standards created by the FIDO Alliance and the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

roles.title: Master of Science in Computer Engineering
roles.description: During my Master of Science, I've competed in the CyberChallenge.IT, ranking top among 20 students in participating at the program in 2021. As a team leader at Challenge@PoliTo with Aruba S.p.A, me and my team developed password-less access methodologies using FIDO 2.0. I've participated in BIP CyberSec Talent Week and IEEE Eurocon 2023 competitions. My technical expertise includes IAM solutions using Keycloak and OPA, with automation on Kubernetes using CI/CD tools that I developed working on my thesis as an intern Liquid Reply. Beyond tech, I've dedicated 230+ hours as a teaching assistant, embodying IEEE-HKN principles as a member and young professional. I've organized events and led the Mu Nu Chapter at Politecnico, showcasing leadership, character, and attitude.
